descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B13 · P1 · 新

已经按保留期清掉的数据会被写回：清理前就开着的旧标签页点 Save Medications / Vitals / Labs，或手机上没发出去的本地副本一打开病历，就把旧数据当成刚记录的重新存回去

票：TFA-94699 in progress · 算 QA bug：否（票在做） · 在哪发现：本地

注：和 B10 同一类机制：旧客户端状态覆盖服务器，没有版本校验

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-25/S27

思路 / Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S25 「清除后没有任何东西能把数据带回来：第 3 天的处理、过期的标签页、Ask AI 和记录上下文」 After the purge nothing brings the data back: day-3 processing, a stale tab, Ask AI and the note context

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T6 A medication row, task or Important Point removed by the purge never comes back unless it is dictated again: not re-extracted from kept history (transcript, previous note, carry-forward line, medicat …（TFA-94699 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U11 Live patient data never survives past its window: once an item clears, no copy of it remains anywhere live (other fields of the chart, dated histories, the patient-list row, handoffs, drafts). …（UAT OAT-04 Expected 2；UAT 3.7 (retention claim)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U4 Hospital vitals, labs and imaging are deleted 36 h after they were last refreshed: a vital and a lab not refreshed for 37 h are gone.（UAT OAT-04 (B)；UAT OAT-04 step 1；UAT 3.6；UAT 3.7；TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: vitals, labs, imaging 36 h)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U5 Hospital active medication rows are deleted 36 h after their last mention: an active row not mentioned for 37 h is gone.（UAT OAT-04 (B)；UAT OAT-04 step 1；UAT 3.6；TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: active med rows)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U7 Hospital open tasks are deleted 36 h after the chart was last processed: an open task on a chart not processed for 37 h is gone.（UAT OAT-04 (B)；UAT OAT-04 step 1；UAT 3.6；TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: open tasks)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • T1 'Last refreshed' for vitals, labs and imaging means a new value was recorded: saving (pre-round Save Note, a panel save, Generate) without a new value does not restart their 36 h clock. …（TFA-94699 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given Hospital patient A2 after a 37 h purge of BP 142/88, Cr 1.6, active 'lisinopril 10 mg daily', held 'metoprolol 25 mg, held for bradycardia' and open task 'Recheck BMP', while history that is still kept names them: yesterday's transcript, a previous note, the nextPreRoundSummary carry-forward line and medicationEvents. …

When (a) Day 3 on A2: a pre-round Save Note and a Save & Extract whose text mentions none of these items. (b) In the stale tab, tap Save Vitals and Save Labs without changing anything. (c) Build the Ask AI context (buildAskContext) and the note-generation context for A from the stored chart, and ask Ask AI 'What were the l …

Then (a) No purged row, task or point is re-created on A2. (b) A2's vitals and labs stay empty; no purged value is stored again with a fresh clock. (c) Neither context for A contains '142/88', '1.6' or 'metoprolol'; the Ask AI answer says the values are not available and names none of them

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：TFA-94699 AC 5 read for purge deletions (T6), AC 2, 3.4 (nothing not stored) and the 3.7 retention claim / OAT-04 Expected 2 (U11): any purged item re-created by (a), any purged value back in vitals or labs after (b), or any marker in a context in (c) = Fail. (c) is decided by the deterministic context check; …

在哪跑：本地 retention（改时钟看保留期）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（blocked）

S25 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-04.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：新的产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-94699 in progress

清理之前就开着的旧标签页会把删掉的数据写回去：点 Save Medications 会恢复已清掉的 lisinopril 和停用的 metoprolol，点 Save Vitals / Save Labs 会把已清掉的血压 142/88、肌酐 1.6 当成刚记录的重新存进去。

A browser tab left open on the chart from before the purge writes deleted data back: Save Medications restores the purged lisinopril and held metoprolol rows, and Save Vitals / Save Labs store the purged BP 142/88 and creatinine 1.6 again as if recorded now.

依据：allure 74b1c9e3-…-result.json; retention lane (convex-5910.log lines 95-103). 8 checks pass, 4 fail: b.vitals, b.labs and b.meds are not in the matrix knownGaps (the S25 scenario has none), and a.task is known K2. Breaks TFA-94699 AC 5 (a deleted med row is not written back by a stale client), AC 2 and UAT 3.7. It is the same stale-tab class as dev report §2 #1 (U30, Quick Dictation overwrite), but a different write path, and it is not recorded. Day-3 processing, Ask AI and the note context brought nothing back.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane retention。

测试方法：API · 接口（Convex 函数）；辅助：MULTI · 多端 / 多账号 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：retention。
